name: Marsh marigold
note: Marsh marigold, Caltha palustris (docs/future/10). Drawn with the iris shader (draw: iris; flora-iris.wgsl), so its keys are the iris's: a low clump of broad, spreading leaves and many small golden flowers on short stalks, the first strong colour of spring. habitat, growth, flowering, dormant, spread and starter work as in reeds.json: marigold wants soaked, flat ground at a pond's edge or in a marsh, wetter than iris likes and a little standing water is fine, never salt; it shuns bare rock and steep banks (the ground-type and slope axes). It flowers early, from the first days of spring, and dies back in winter. spread kind seed: its seeds float, so a mature clump drops one every everyH hours distanceM away.
